description: The first-entry paint at app/cbl/COADM01C.cbl:87-90, and the ENTER half of the pair gate G38 asks for. A 160-byte communication area arrives, so EIBCALEN is not zero and line 82 falls through to the ELSE at 85 where line 86 copies DFHCOMMAREA into CARDDEMO-COMMAREA; it carries CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT 0, so IF NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER at line 87 is true. Line 88 sets CDEMO-PGM-REENTER, which is why the response hands back context 1 and a second request over the same screen would take the REENTER arm instead of this one; line 89 moves LOW-VALUES to COADM1AO; line 90 performs SEND-MENU-SCREEN. The sibling case01 is the EIBCALEN = 0 arm that line 82 takes ahead of this one, and the REENTER arm's EVALUATE EIBAID at 93-103 is driven arm by arm by case09, case10 and case11. EIBAID is not read anywhere on this path: the EVALUATE at line 93 sits inside the ELSE of line 87 and is never reached, so the DFHENTER declared in screenRequest is only the attention identifier a real invocation carries in EIBAID, and nothing asserted below depends on it - no reader should infer that the key mattered here. The same holds for the option field, because RECEIVE-MENU-SCREEN at 189-197 does not run: nothing is received, no option is read and no validation executes. All twenty name-labelled fields of COADM1AO are pinned, and each is one of exactly four kinds. Six are written by POPULATE-HEADER-INFO at 202-221: TITLE01O and TITLE02O are CCDA-TITLE01 and CCDA-TITLE02 verbatim from app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy, TRNNAMEO and PGMNAMEO are the WS-TRANID 'CA00' and WS-PGMNAME 'COADM01C' of lines 37 and 36, and CURDATEO '07/19/22' and CURTIMEO '23:12:32' are WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY and WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS rendered from the pinned clock, the year narrowed to two digits by the WS-CURDATE-YEAR(3:2) reference modification at line 213. Four are composed by BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS at 226-263, each one a CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-NUM PIC 9(02), then '. ', then a CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-NAME PIC X(35) taken from app/cpy/COADM02Y.cpy, STRINGed into the WS-ADMIN-OPT-TXT that line 231 blanked first - so 39 bytes are composed and the fortieth stays the space it already was. Nine hold LOW-VALUES rather than spaces, and that distinction is the point of this case. CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-COUNT is 4, so the bound at line 229 stops the loop after subscript 4 and OPTN005O through OPTN012O are never written; OPTIONO is never written either, because the only statement that writes it is line 125, inside the PROCESS-ENTER-KEY this path does not perform. What those nine fields hold is therefore precisely what line 89 put there, X'00' at every byte, which is why they are encoded as \u0000 forty times over and twice over rather than as blanks. Expecting spaces would assert a MOVE SPACES that no paragraph on this path issues, and would pass just as readily against a translation that had dropped line 89 altogether. The twentieth field, ERRMSGO, is the one written out of working storage: line 79 blanked WS-MESSAGE, nothing here overwrote it, and line 177 narrows those 80 blank bytes into the 78 that app/cpy-bms/COADM01.CPY declares for the field at line 138, which the LENGTH=78 of app/bms/COADM01.bms:156 corroborates. The run emits them on the SCREEN_ERRMSG_78 channel, the same channel and the same ordering case01 uses, because the 80-byte WS-MESSAGE of line 38 is working storage and only a controller produces the screen field it narrows into. ERRMSGC keeps the COLOR=RED that app/bms/COADM01.bms:154-157 declares for ERRMSG, because the single attribute byte COADM01C ever writes is the DFHGREEN of line 148, on the coming-soon path this case never reaches. Termination is RETURN_TRANSID: SEND-MENU-SCREEN returns to MAIN-PARA and the RETURN at 107-110 names TRANSID('CA00') and passes CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, so unlike the XCTL cases the conversation continues and the mapset and map the next request must quote come back as COADM01 and COADM1A. No dataset is touched - COADM01C declares no SELECT and no FD and issues no file control command - so inputs, expectedWrites and expectedFinalState are all empty, the return code is 0, and gates G19, G21 and G47 have nothing to bind to here. The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:32, the timestamp COADM01C's own version footer at line 267 carries, so the instant is anchored in the source rather than chosen, and all twenty cases in this directory pin that same instant and name US-ASCII explicitly rather than leaving a code page to a platform default. Unlike case01, this path does perform POPULATE-HEADER-INFO, so the instant is load-bearing here: CURDATEO and CURTIMEO are read straight off it. Every expected value above is statically derived - read out of the COBOL paragraph that produces it and cross-checked against the 160-byte layout of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, the option table of app/cpy/COADM02Y.cpy, the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COADM01.CPY and the DFHMDF definitions of app/bms/COADM01.bms - and none of it was captured from an execution of the legacy program, which is empirically impossible here: no z/OS or CICS runtime, an indexed file handler the available compiler reports as disabled, no Language Environment CEE services, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR absent from the repository. ParityCase's own class documentation is the authoritative statement of that provenance, and the substitution is escalated rather than absorbed (risk R-A).
